title: Make plain Codex resume the canonical Herdr wake transport
objective: Implement a repository-local provider-free wake transport that binds the current Herdr-hosted Codex session and uses plain codex resume SESSION_ID MESSAGE, confirms the unique wake message from authoritative rollout records, terminates only the temporary resume process group, and preserves exactly-once event consumption and pause-after-current ordering.
scope: authoritative Herdr Codex session binding and stale tmux authority detection
plain codex resume subprocess transport in its own process group
deterministic rollout acceptance and turn-began confirmation
temporary frontend process-group cleanup and duplicate-process proof
busy and uncertain delivery classification without model polling

may: inspect installed Codex source and rollout record shapes read-only
modify repository source, CLI, tests, and documentation
add repository-local scripts for deterministic resume delivery
run focused and full deterministic verification
may_not: modify sibling repositories, global Codex configuration, or Herdr configuration
use codex exec resume, tmux send-keys, Herdr agent.prompt, terminal input, or raw child output in wake messages
clear, overwrite, submit, or otherwise mutate a human draft
use arbitrary sleep or model polling as delivery confirmation
weaken authority, generation, dispatcher, event, lease, rollout, or process fences
push, merge, deploy, install server-wide, or initialize another repository

relevant_context: The operator has proven manually and from a Runner-like detached process that plain codex resume SESSION_ID MESSAGE reaches the already-open Herdr Codex session and leaves the original TUI usable.
The current authoritative rollout/session is 01a05dd0-0773-79a2-83b9-4fa2cf7c8ec3 in this repository.
The old tmux Codex supervisor and abandoned manual resume frontends were terminated after exact process-group checks; the tmux session no longer exists.
Generation 13 recovery preserved supervisor-1005d601-4da1-4f6b-a7fa-f0b71dedabbe and classified no_active_work.
The persisted v1 session binding is intentionally stale and must fail closed until replaced with the current Herdr session binding.
The canonical message is exactly OPSLE_WAKE v1 event=EVENT_ID gen=N; read durable state.

A successful transport must observe the exact unique message as an accepted user message in the bound rollout and deterministic evidence that its turn began before terminating the temporary frontend process group.

If submission is rejected as busy before acceptance, retain the request and retry only after filesystem or rollout state change. If acceptance is uncertain after spawn, record UNCERTAIN and never blindly replay.
Herdr is the authoritative host; tmux remains a fallback mechanism but terminal keystroke injection is not canonical.
expected_deliverable: A narrow implementation and deterministic tests for the canonical plain codex resume transport, authoritative Herdr binding, rollout confirmation, process-group cleanup, exact-once fences, safe busy behavior, and correct pause-after-current ordering.
expected_evidence: session binding rejects repository, supervisor, generation, session, rollout, host, and supersession drift
transport argv is exactly codex resume SESSION_ID MESSAGE and is detached into its own process group
delivery is confirmed only from the bound rollout's exact unique message plus turn-began record
confirmed delivery terminates the temporary process group and proves it exited
busy before acceptance remains queued and retry is event-driven
uncertain after possible acceptance is never automatically replayed
duplicate delivery, event consumption, generation mismatch, and stale dispatcher tests pass
pause-after-current applies only after accept or reject
focused tests and npm run verify pass
acceptance_criteria: plain codex resume is the only canonical automatic transport for the Herdr binding
no tmux keystroke or Herdr prompt path is invoked
the old tmux authority cannot coexist with a valid authoritative Herdr binding
delivery confirmation and frontend cleanup are deterministic and durable
human composer state is never inspected through terminal scraping or mutated by Opsle
busy and uncertainty do not cause blind replay
event evaluation remains idempotent and generation-fenced
pause-after-current preserves current evaluation before PAUSED
focused and full verification pass with no unexpected files
prohibited_actions: raw child output in wake messages
history rewriting, merge, deployment, global install, or sibling mutation
operator_policy_constraints: Codex enabled with configured model and reasoning effort
